title.quote:
LLMs and Stack Overflow Discussions: Reliability,
Impact, and Challenges
title.justification: Title as given on the paper's first page.
title.value: LLMs and Stack Overflow Discussions: Reliability, Impact, and Challenges

extractions.description: An empirical study that mines Stack Overflow questions before and after ChatGPT's release, prompts ChatGPT-3.5 and LLaMA-2-7b to answer a sample of them, compares generated answers with accepted human answers via textual (cosine) and LLM-judged semantic similarity plus sentiment analysis, and statistically analyses the decline of Stack Overflow posting and user activity overall and by domain.

type.quote: We conducted an empirical study analyzing questions from Stack Overflow and using these LLMs to address them.
type.justification: The paper explicitly describes itself as an empirical study with data mining, prompting and statistical tests.

name.quote: evaluating the reliability of LLMs in Software Engineering while assisting developers with their daily tasks is a relevant and important topic
name.justification: The study evaluates LLM reliability in assisting developers, a software engineering concern.

name.quote: Keywords: ChatGPT, LLaMa, Stack Overflow, Empirical study, Reliability
name.justification: Listed as a keyword and the study methodology.

name.quote: With the advance of Large Language Models (LLMs), practitioners and researchers have explored the potential of leveraging LLMs for different software engineering tasks
name.justification: The paper evaluates and compares LLMs and discusses implications for model developers.

name.quote: With millions to billions of parameters, LLMs are used for various natural language processing tasks.
name.justification: LLMs and similarity/sentiment analysis are NLP tasks used as tooling here.
